将任何图像变成逼真的照片

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

步骤 1. 上传您的图片。插图、动漫框架、3D 渲染或概念艺术。 Anything2Real 在改变外观的同时保留您的构图和结构。适用于：动漫·插图·3D 渲染·概念艺术

步骤 2. 设置真实感提示（可选）。该提示已预先加载，以获得自然的照片外观。交换前缀来引导风格，例如工作室灯光或特定的胶片。

步骤 3. 点击运行并下载。您将获得图像的真实感版本，并裁剪为原始帧。在工作流程中预览，然后下载。适用于：Photoshop · Figma · Canva · 任何编辑器

第一次？将所有设置保留原样。默认值（20 个步骤·欧拉·预加载的现实主义提示）是几乎任何图像的正确起点。

概述

此工作流程使用 FLUX.2 Klein 9B 和 Anything2Real LoRA 将任何图像转换为逼真的照片。你向它提供插图、动画框架、3D 渲染或概念艺术，它会渲染真实照片版本，同时保留原始构图、结构和内容。潜在参考将结构锁定到位，因此输出与您的输入相匹配，而不是漂移到新图像中。第二个 Turbo LoRA 可保持快速生成。您上传图像，根据需要调整提示，然后在一分钟多一点的时间内返回照片。无需设置，无需连接节点。

适合对象：想要在 ComfyUI 中将风格化艺术转化为照片级真实图像的创作者，而无需从头开始设置模型和 LoRA。不适合：彻底重塑您的形象。它会保留您的构图，因此会将您制作的内容渲染为照片，而不会重新设计它。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 上传您想要使其逼真的图像。

  2. 保留默认的真实提示，或交换前缀以引导外观，然后运行。

  3. 下载照片，裁剪为原始框架，可供任何编辑器使用。

期望模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。每个图像在一分钟多一点的时间内返回，平铺的 VAE 可以在高分辨率下保持输出清晰。需要了解的一个限制是：高度风格化或抽象的输入在放入照片中时可能会显得不可思议，因此您的图像越接近真实比例，结果就越令人信服。

使用案例

动漫和照片插图。将动画帧或插图渲染为真实照片，同时保留场景。

概念艺术变为现实。将绘制的概念艺术转变为宣传或情绪板的真实参考。

3D 渲染到照片。将 3D 渲染转换为照片，使其看起来像真实的，而不是 CG。

角色和产品模型。在提交之前，将风格化的角色或产品视为真实照片。

o.en:
Turn any image into a photorealistic photo

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Upload your image. An illustration, an anime frame, a 3D render, or concept art. Anything2Real keeps your composition and structure while it converts the look. Works great with: anime · illustrations · 3D renders · concept art

Step 2. Set the realism prompt (optional). The prompt is pre-loaded for a natural photo look. Swap the prefix to steer the style, like studio lighting or a specific film stock.

Step 3. Hit run and download. You get back a photorealistic version of your image, cropped to the original frame. Preview it in the workflow, then download. Ready for: Photoshop · Figma · Canva · any editor

First time? Leave every setting as-is. The default (20 steps · Euler · pre-loaded realism prompt) is the right starting point for almost any image.

Overview

This workflow converts any image into a photorealistic photo using FLUX.2 Klein 9B and the Anything2Real LoRA. You feed it an illustration, an anime frame, a 3D render, or concept art, and it renders a real-photo version while keeping the original composition, structure, and content. A reference latent locks the structure in place, so the output matches your input instead of drifting into a new image. A second Turbo LoRA keeps generation fast. You upload an image, adjust the prompt if you want, and get back the photo in a little over a minute. No setup, no nodes to wire.

Who it's for: creators who want to turn stylized art into photoreal images in ComfyUI without setting up the models and LoRAs from scratch. Not for: a full reinvention of your image. It keeps your composition, so it renders what you made as a photo, it does not redesign it.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Upload the image you want to make photorealistic.

  2. Keep the default realism prompt, or swap the prefix to steer the look, then run.

  3. Download the photo, cropped to your original frame, ready for any editor.

ExpectationsThe models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. Each image comes back in a little over a minute, and the tiled VAE keeps output sharp at high resolution. One limit to know: heavily stylized or abstract inputs can look uncanny when pushed into a photo, so the closer your image is to real proportions, the more convincing the result.

Use Cases

Anime & Illustration to Photo. Render anime frames or illustrations as real photographs while keeping the scene.

Concept Art to Real. Turn painted concept art into a photoreal reference for pitches or mood boards.

3D Render to Photo. Convert a 3D render into a photograph so it reads as real, not CG.

Character & Product Mockups. See a stylized character or product as a real photo before you commit.
